errors.trigger: App artifacts or blueprint inputs are missing
errors.diagnosis: The integration path cannot be wired because required files are absent
errors.rescue_action: List missing files and suggest completing the relevant forge/check step
errors.user_message: Required artifacts are missing: {artifacts}. Complete them before weaving.

errors.trigger: Required stages not done or not checked
errors.diagnosis: One or more app stages are not completed and checked
errors.rescue_action: List missing stages and suggest completing them first
errors.user_message: Required stages not yet complete: {stages}. Complete them before weaving.

errors.trigger: Operator does not approve the wiring plan
errors.diagnosis: The checkpoint gate was not approved
errors.rescue_action: Leave files unchanged and wait for approval or requested edits
errors.user_message: Weaving is pending approval. No files were changed.

errors.trigger: Integration test fails or integration write fails
errors.diagnosis: The wired end-to-end flow fails its integration test or cannot be written safely
errors.rescue_action: Set last_error, suggest /fab-trace integration, and preserve original files where possible
errors.user_message: Integration failed or could not be written safely. Run /fab-trace integration.

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Integration verification or phase transition would corrupt run state
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not replace fabrica.run.json
errors.user_message: The candidate run state failed validation. No state was written.
